notes.title: Ver 0.9.001 Updates
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Updates
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with water surfaces on the Dam map.
[*] Fixed a bug where the passive Guard effect would not take effect after the active effect of a Guard skill ended.
[*] Fixed the issue that when the poison circle is minimized, the status does not disappear after leaving the poison circle.
[*] Optimized the description for the Core - [Assault Module] status effect.
[*] Corrected logical errors in the Leader Core.
[*] Adjusted the duration of the status effect for the skill - [Polar Permafrost].
[*] Reduced the difficulty of Stage 20.
[*] In PvP battles, disconnecting or quitting during matchmaking will now deduct a participation count. The opponent remains unaffected and will have deducted durability restored.
[*] Fixed grid data issues on the Dam map bridge in PvP mode.
[*] Resolved a bug where core-related aura effects were not being applied.
[*] Fixed a visual glitch with the cooldown display for basic attacks.
[/list]

[*] Corrected logical errors in the Leader Core.
